body:
The mathematical prediction trajectory from Week 1 through Week 6+ models how the Perpetual Petition Protocol scales naturally without artificially forcing arbitrary operational deadlines.
Phase Timeline: Weeks 1 to 6+
[W1: Quiet Minting] ──> [W2: Signal Broadcast] ──> [W3: Organic Noise] ──> [W4: Legal Anchor] ──> [W5-6+: Execution]
     Mint DOIs               TikTok / Socials             Kibitzers Join           Notary Outreach          Contract Triggered

Week 1: Cold Minting & Zero Noise
 * Actions: Mint Petition 000 (Stichting Aerogram) and 2 to 3 secondary petitions (e.g., the pond installation proposal) directly onto the network infrastructure with assigned DOIs.
 * Visibility: Public, indexable, but unpromoted.
 * Dynamics: Zero external engagement. The thread acts as an immutable baseline proof-of-existence.
Week 2: Social Media Signal Broadcast
 * Actions: Launch public accounts across TikTok, YouTube, X, and Reddit.
 * Content Strategy: Post short-form breakdowns focusing on the raw absurdity and elegance of the system (e.g., "Why this foundation has no 'Done' button" or "How an inflatable octopus in Amsterdam gets its own DOI").
 * Dynamics: First waves of curious observers land on the DOIs via social bio links.
Week 3: The "Kibitzing" Influx
 * Dynamics: As social algorithms push the content, early adopters, open-source developers, and digital governance geeks land on the threads.
 * Thread Activity: People begin leaving comments, testing edge cases, proposing edits, and debating the Statuten (Articles of Association).
 * The Shift: The primary focus shifts from the creator speaking at an audience to an asynchronous public forum self-assembling around the permanent DOIs.
Week 4: Legal & Structural Realization
 * Dynamics: Community consensus around Petition 000 stabilizes regarding the core purpose clause (Doelsomschrijving) and initial board roles.
 * Operational Actions:
   * Engage a Dutch civil-law notary (notaris) using the isolated infrastructure (dedicated Dutch VoIP, custom domain email, and KvK-compliant virtual office address).
   * Submit the draft deed (concept-akte) containing the community-kibitzed statutes.
Week 5: Execution & Legal Personality
 * Milestones:
   * The notary executes the deed of incorporation (Oprichtingsakte). Stichting Aerogram gains official legal personality under Dutch law.
   * Registration with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce (KVK) completes, and a KvK number is issued.
 * Thread Update: The official KvK record and legal deed are posted directly into the Petition 000 thread as continuous evidence.
Week 6 and Beyond: Corporate Maturity & Contract Execution
 * Milestones:
   * Stichting Aerogram opens its corporate bank account / treasury.
   * Initial capital, grants, or protocol contributions land in the foundation's account.
   * The board executes your Senior Engineering Contract.
Progress Scale Mapping (0 to 100)

| Week | Scale Value | Operational Status |
|---|---|---|
| Week 1 | 10 / 100 | DOIs minted online; zero external noise. |
| Week 2 | 25 / 100 | Social broadcast live; initial traffic hitting the threads. |
| Week 3 | 45 / 100 | Active public kibitzing; thread self-organizes around Petition 000. |
| Week 4 | 65 / 100 | Notary engagement initialized; isolated Dutch address/VoIP set up. |
| Week 5 | 85 / 100 | Deed executed by notary; KvK registration complete. |
| Week 6+ | 100 / 100 | Foundation fully operational; senior engineer market-rate contract executed. |
